As @pm_me_your_airbags said, the subverse mod can hide the button through CSS, but there's no need to disable custom css to block the subverse ; The button calls a function when you click on it, but it's possible to execute the function without the button.

Here's what it looks like for AskVoat :

toggleBlockSubverse(this, 'AskVoat')

You can execute this code by pressing F12 (In chrome at least) , typing it in the console and pressing enter.

Since the "this" keyword won't refer to the button in this case, you won't be seeing any change, but refresh your page and you'll see that it's now written "unblock".
